title: Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution
title_zh: 环境对决：大语言模型共同演化的缩影

paragraphs.en: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels , a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B , the learner’s hint lift on an author’s environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model’s. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels .
paragraphs.zh: 通过从合成训练流水线到开放网络上共享数据等纷繁复杂的现实世界交互，前沿大语言模型会吸收其前代模型和竞争对手所创造的内容。 在这个生态系统中，每个模型作为创造者和求解者，扮演自身角色的能力如何？ 我们提出 Environment Duels，这是一个动态智能体基准，可在交互式环境中评估这两项能力。 每个模型编写环境，每个环境附带一条特权提示，目标是让有能力的求解者在没有该提示时失败、在获得该提示时通过。 在九个前沿大语言模型上的实验表明，求解与编写是两种截然不同的能力：最强的求解者并非最强的编写者，而较小的模型更能从他人的解题方式中学习，并能编写出最难的环境和最有用的提示。 除了分数之外，这些两两交互还构成了模型如何相互影响的缩影。 两两对弈的结果具有传递性，因此能产生稳定的排名；独立的编写者会收敛到相同的设计；在一项基于 Qwen3.8-27B 的强化学习研究中，学习者在某个编写者环境上的提示增益，能够追踪这些环境的训练对其在保留集上的推理和智能体基准的提升幅度，无论这些环境来自其自身还是其他模型。 这些模式中的每一种，在对弈之外模型如何相互塑造的过程中都有对应的体现。 通过在受控条件下呈现这些交互，Environment Duels 为观察大语言模型如何相互教学、相互挑战和相互学习提供了一扇窗口。 代码已发布于 https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels 。

paragraphs.en: Every frontier LLM is now, in part, a student of its predecessors and competitors. Model developers describe pipelines in which one model authors coding challenges, math problems or reasoning environments, and the next model trains on them ( Xu et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2025a ; Cai et al., 2025 ) . The same synthetic data spreads through public repositories and benchmarks, where other labs’ training runs ingest it ( Drayson et al., 2025 ) . Models thus co-evolve: each one’s training distribution is shaped by what other models chose to write. When a lab closes this loop deliberately, having its own models write the curriculum for the next generation, the process becomes recursive self-improvement in a concrete engineering sense. Either way, what a model learns depends on how well another model can write problems worth learning from ( Xu et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 如今，每一个前沿大语言模型在某种程度上都是其前身与竞争对手的学生。 模型开发者描述了这样的流水线：一个模型编写编程挑战、数学题目或推理环境，下一个模型在这些内容上进行训练（Xu et al., 2026a；Zhao et al., 2025a；Cai et al., 2025）。 同样的合成数据还会通过公开代码库和基准测试传播，被其他实验室的训练流程所吸收（Drayson et al., 2025）。 因此，模型在共同演化：每个模型的训练分布都由其他模型选择写下的内容所塑造。 当一个实验室有意闭合这一循环，让自己的模型为下一代编写课程时，这一过程就成为具体工程意义上的递归自我改进。 无论哪种方式，一个模型能学到什么，取决于另一个模型能否把问题写得值得学习（Xu et al., 2025b）。

paragraphs.en: A model’s skill as an author therefore shapes what the next generation learns, in its own family or a competitor’s. Language models now match or exceed human performance on many established benchmarks ( Center for AI Safety et al., 2026 ) . As they do, sufficiently challenging human-authored tasks become increasingly costly to curate ( Henniger and Poesia, 2026 ) , and recent progress on long-standing open problems, including Millennium Prize conjectures ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , suggests that even the supply of unsolved challenges a model can train on is finite. Once the stock of existing problems thins out, the bottleneck moves: what matters is the ability to pose new problems that are worth solving. A model that can formulate well-specified, novel challenges, and calibrate their difficulty to push the boundaries of current methods, is the kind of capability that could drive fully autonomous scientific research.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一个模型作为作者的技能会影响下一代模型在其自身家族或竞争对手家族中所学到的东西。 语言模型如今在许多既定基准测试上已达到或超越人类水平（Center for AI Safety et al., 2026）。 与此同时，收集足够有挑战性的人工编写任务的成本越来越高（Henniger and Poesia, 2026），而模型在长期悬而未决的开放性问题上的近期进展，包括千禧年大奖难题（OpenAI, 2026a），表明即便是模型可用于训练的未解难题的储备也是有限的。 一旦现有问题储备日渐稀少，瓶颈便随之转移：关键在于提出值得解决的新问题的能力。 能够明确表述全新的挑战，并校准其难度以推动当前方法突破边界的模型，正是能够驱动 fully 自主科学研究的那种能力——即完全自主的科学研究能力。 等等，修正第5句：5. 能够明确表述全新的挑战，并校准其难度以推动当前方法突破边界的能力，正是驱动完全自主科学研究所需的能力。

paragraphs.en: Environment Duels builds a microcosm of this ecosystem. Every model plays two roles: it writes executable environments for the others to solve, and it solves the environments they write. An environment is an interactive program with hidden state, a reward and an action budget, a richer format than a static text question: solvers must explore, act and adapt over many turns rather than answer once. Each author also supplies a privileged hint that lets a solver approach its environment correctly, and aims for an environment that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. After the first round, each author sees how the others actually played and answers with one counter-move. We run this duel among nine frontier models, 90 environments and 12,960 episodes in all, and score each model on how well it solves ( solve rate ), how hard its environments are ( difficulty ), and how much its hints help ( hint lift ).
paragraphs.zh: Environment Duels 构建了这一生态系统的一个缩影。 每个模型扮演两种角色：它为其他模型编写可执行的环境供其求解，同时也求解其他模型编写的环境。 环境是一个带有隐藏状态、奖励和行动预算的交互式程序，比静态文本问题更丰富：求解者必须探索、行动并在多轮中适应，而不是一次性作答。 每位出题者还需提供一个特权提示，让求解者能正确地应对其环境，目标是设计出让有能力的求解者在没有提示时失败、有提示时通过的环境。 第一轮之后，每位出题者会观察其他模型实际的表现，并以一步应对之策作为回应。 我们在九个前沿模型、90 个环境和共 12,960 个回合上进行这场对决，并从求解表现（解决率）、环境难度（难度）以及提示的作用（提示增益）三个维度对每个模型进行评分。

paragraphs.en: What emerges resembles the ecosystem outside the duel. The models that solve best are not the ones whose environments teach best: smaller models learn more from how others played, and their counter-moves produce the hardest environments and the most useful hints. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash , for example, writes the hardest environments of all nine models, and its developers report training it heavily on synthetic environments ( Xu et al., 2026a ) , an independent sign that the duel measures a skill that training can build. The duel also carries signal beyond itself: how much an author’s hints help a learner anticipates how much that learner gains from training on the author’s environments.
paragraphs.zh: 最终呈现的结果与对决之外的生态系统颇为相似。 解答表现最好的模型并非那些环境教学效果最好的模型：较小的模型从其他模型的玩法中学到更多，而它们的反制手段产生了最困难的环境和最有用的提示。 例如，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在全部九个模型中编写出最困难的环境，其开发者报告称在合成环境上对其进行了大量训练（Xu et al., 2026a），这是一个独立的证据，表明该对决所衡量的是一种可以通过训练培养的技能。 这种对决还带有超出自身的信号：作者的提示对学习者的帮助程度，可以预示该学习者通过在作者的环境上训练所获得的收益。

paragraphs.en: All environments, the pipeline that generates them, the solver trajectories and the analysis code will be released, and Environment Duels will be updated as new models enter.

paragraphs.en: In Environment Duels, every evaluated model is both an author and a solver. A designer writes an executable environment together with a privileged hint; every other model then plays it twice on identical instances, once with the hint in its context and once without. Measured outcomes then return to the designer, which answers with one counter-move, a revised environment shaped by how the other models played. Figure 1 summarises the framework. We describe construction (Section 2.1 ), then the duel and its scores (Section 2.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在环境对决中，每个被评估的模型既是作者也是求解者。 设计者编写一个可执行的环境并附带一条特权提示；然后其他每个模型在相同实例上玩两次，一次上下文中含该提示，一次不含。 测得的结果随后返回给设计者，设计者以一步反制回应，即根据其他模型的游玩方式修订后的环境。 图 1 总结了该框架。 我们先描述构建方式（第 2.1 节），然后描述对决及其得分（第 2.2 节）。

sents.en: Measured outcomes then return to the designer, which answers with one counter-move, a revised environment shaped by how the other models played.
sents.zh: 测得的结果随后返回给设计者，设计者以一步反制回应，即根据其他模型的游玩方式修订后的环境。

paragraphs.en: Before writing any code, the author produces a design specification, the exact hint that solvers will receive, and a private feasibility analysis: a proposed hinted strategy with turn and resource accounting. This analysis is written reasoning rather than an executable action sequence, and neither it nor the plan is ever shown to solvers. A dedicated planning call reserves the author’s full reasoning budget for task design: working out the core difficulty, the conditions under which the hint resolves it, and an adversarial check against simple bypass strategies. This keeps the design effort separate from implementation effort, so that the environments are harder and better calibrated.
paragraphs.zh: 在编写任何代码之前，作者会先产出一份设计规范（也就是求解者将收到的确切提示）以及一份私密的可行性分析：即一个带有回合与资源核算的建议提示策略。 这份分析是书面的推理而非可执行的动作序列，且它和该计划都不会展示给求解者。 一次专用的规划调用会为任务设计保留作者的完整推理预算：用以构思核心难点、提示在何种条件下能化解该难点，以及针对简单绕过策略进行对抗性检验。 这使设计工作与实现工作分离开来，从而让环境更难且校准得更好。

paragraphs.en: The pair ( e , h ) (e,h) must pass both a programmatic execution check and a self-review by the author in a fresh session before e e is admitted to the duel. A programmatic execution check runs e e in an isolated sandbox (no file-system or network access, fixed time and memory limits), resets it on two seeds and plays a few probe actions to confirm that observations, rewards and termination flags are well formed. For the self-review, the author examines the anonymised ( e , h ) (e,h) in a fresh session for reachability within T T , instruction consistency, information sufficiency and hint correctness. If the self-review rejects ( e , h ) (e,h) as invalid, the workflow returns to planning: the author revises the plan and hint before generating a fresh implementation. After the duel runs, we audit environment–seed instances for which no evaluated model succeeds in at least one hint condition. Each flagged instance undergoes a white-box LLM audit with access to the environment source code and solver trajectories, and a separate manual review. We exclude flagged instances judged invalid by both audits from downstream metrics; the other seeds of the same environment remain eligible. Appendix A reports the audit procedure and results.

paragraphs.en: This is where authors and solvers co-evolve. An author designs its environment blind; once every play has returned, it sees how the other models actually played and answers with one revised version. Alongside anonymised outcome statistics, it receives three matched trajectory pairs, each showing one solver’s full attempt on one seed without and with the hint, which reveal shortcuts the solvers found and hints they ignored or misread. The author may change the environment, the hint or both, but must preserve the task, interface, reward contract, action budget and seed-to-instance mapping, so each seed poses the same instance before and after. The revised version passes through the same construction stages, is played again by every model in both conditions, and is the version all reported scores use.
paragraphs.zh: 这正是作者与解题者共同进化的地方。 作者在盲设环境中进行设计；当所有对局返回后，它能看到其他模型实际如何对局，并以一个修订版本作出回应。 除匿名的结果统计外，它还会收到三组配对的轨迹，每组展示某个智能体在有无提示两种情况下对同一个种子的完整尝试，从中可以看出智能体发现的捷径，以及它们忽略或误读的提示。 作者可以修改环境、提示或两者都修改，但必须保留任务、接口、奖励契约、动作预算以及种子到实例的映射，因此每个种子在修改前后呈现的是同一个实例。 修订版本经过与之前相同的构建阶段，再次被所有模型在两种条件下对局，并且所有报告的分数都以该版本为准。

paragraphs.en: The counter-move is one round of co-evolution: authors adapt to the solvers they face, and a single round raises both difficulty and hint lift, with the no-hint pass rate falling from 84.9% to 78.5% and hint lift rising from 6.3% to 13.4%. Authors can thus take feedback from other models and turn it into harder, better-calibrated environments. Such loops are increasingly common outside the duel. A user who consults an LLM council sends one question to several models, which review and rank one another’s answers before one of them writes the final response ( Karpathy, 2025 ) ; related systems let models debate or build on each other’s outputs ( Du et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025b ) . The counter-move isolates one such loop under controlled conditions; Section 3.2 and Appendix E analyse its effect further.
paragraphs.zh: 这一反制举措是一轮共同演化：出题者会适应其所面对的求解者，单轮演化既提升了难度也提升了提示增益，无提示通过率从84.9%降至78.5%，提示增益从6.3%升至13.4%。 出题者由此可以吸收来自其他模型的反馈，并将其转化为更难、校准更佳的环境。 这类循环在对抗之外也日益常见。 咨询大语言模型议会的用户会向多个模型发送同一个问题，这些模型相互评审并给彼此的答案排序，然后由其中一个写出最终回答（Karpathy, 2025）；相关系统还允许模型进行辩论或在彼此的输出之上构建（Du et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2025；Zhao et al., 2025b）。 这一反制举措在受控条件下隔离出这样一个循环；第3.2节和附录E进一步分析了其影响。

paragraphs.en: We run environment duels with nine frontier models: Claude-Opus-5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , GPT-5.6-Sol ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( Xu et al., 2026a ) , GLM-5.3 ( Zeng et al., 2026a ) , Kimi-K3 ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) , Inkling-Small ( Thinking Machines Lab, 2026 ) , Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , Grok-4.6 ( xAI, 2026 ) and Gemini-3.8-Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) . Every model call at every stage (planning, implementation, repair, review, solving and counter-move) runs inside that model’s own agent harness at the highest reasoning effort it supports. (Appendix B ) Each call starts in an isolated workspace containing only that task’s inputs, and the agent keeps its native tool loop, shell and context management, so authoring and solving are measured under the agentic conditions in which these systems are deployed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用九个前沿模型进行环境对决：Claude-Opus-5（Anthropic，2026）、GPT-5.6-Sol（OpenAI，2026b）、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（Xu 等，2026a）、GLM-5.3（Zeng 等，2026a）、Kimi-K3（Moonshot AI，2026）、Inkling-Small（Thinking Machines Lab，2026）、Qwen3.8-27B（Qwen Team，2026）、Grok-4.6（xAI，2026）以及 Gemini-3.8-Flash（Google DeepMind，2026）。 每一阶段的每次模型调用（规划、实现、修复、评审、求解与反击）都在该模型自身支持的最高推理力度下、于其自带的智能体框架中运行。 （附录 B）每次调用都始于一个仅包含该任务输入的隔离工作区，智能体保持其原生的工具循环、shell 与上下文管理，因此创作与求解都是在这些系统实际部署时所处的智能体化条件下进行度量的。

paragraphs.en: As solvers, the nine models rank much as public capability indices rank them: Claude-Opus-5 and GPT-5.6-Sol lead here, as they do on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index ( Artificial Analysis, 2026 ) (Figure 2 ). On this axis the duel confirms what existing benchmarks measure. It differs from them in how it ages. A fixed test set saturates once models master it, whereas the environments of a duel are written by the models under evaluation, so its ceiling is set by the strongest author rather than fixed in advance. Keeping the benchmark at the frontier therefore requires no new annotation: adding a stronger model adds harder environments, at the cost of tokens alone.
paragraphs.zh: 作为解题者，九个模型的排名与公开能力指数的排名基本一致：Claude-Opus-5 和 GPT-5.6-Sol 在此领先，正如它们在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数（Artificial Analysis, 2026）上的表现（图 2）。 在这个维度上，对决证实了现有基准测试所衡量的内容。 它与现有基准测试的不同之处在于其时效方式。 固定的测试集一旦被模型掌握就会饱和，而对决的环境是由被评估的模型编写的，因此其上限由最强的编写者决定，而不是预先固定的。 因此，保持基准处于前沿无需新的标注：加入一个更强的模型就会带来更难的环境，代价仅仅是 token。

paragraphs.en: The two authoring axes are the ones an author controls: Difficulty measures how hard its environments are without help, and hint lift how much its hints help. On both, the top three places go to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash , Gemini-3.8-Flash and Qwen3.8-27B (on hint lift DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash shares third place with Inkling-Small ), three compact models that rank third, seventh and fourth as solvers. Claude-Opus-5 and GPT-5.6-Sol , the two strongest solvers, rank no higher than fourth on Difficulty and seventh on hint lift. The same three models write nine of the ten environments that Claude-Opus-5 fails at least once.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个创作维度是作者能够控制的：难度衡量其环境在无帮助情况下的难度，提示提升衡量其提示所带来的帮助程度。 在这两个维度上，前三名分别是 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash、Gemini-3.8-Flash 和 Qwen3.8-27B（在提示提升上，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 与 Inkling-Small 并列第三），这三个紧凑型模型作为智能体分别排名第三、第七和第四。 Claude-Opus-5 和 GPT-5.6-Sol 是两个最强的智能体，但它们在难度上排名不超过第四，在提示提升上排名第七。 同样这三个模型创作了 Claude-Opus-5 至少失败一次的十个环境中的九个。

paragraphs.zh: 这些中断是不匹配，而非错误。 顶级提示会将底层 17.7% 的正确尝试变为错误，而其他提示最多为 7.7%，但没有任何层级的提示破坏顶级超过 3.1% 的正确尝试（图 3，右）。 较弱的作者会点出陷阱和应对动作（“坡道……是陷阱”），而最强的作者则陈述机制，把推导留给求解者（“音调在你放置的值上是仿射的”）。 拿到此类提示的较弱求解者会过早提交，并在中位数 13 次动作后失败，而没有该提示时他们曾通过缓慢探索在 20 次动作内成功。 第 4 节表明，这种针对特定学习者的提示提升也能追踪哪些作者的环境最能训练出好的模型。

paragraphs.en: The counter-move makes most environments harder (Figure 4 ), but the two strongest solvers adapt least. GPT-5.6-Sol leaves its environments essentially unchanged, and Claude-Opus-5 changes less than the average author in both pass rate and hint lift, while Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3 lower their pass rates by 13.1 and 10.8 points. Another is that their feedback is weaker: the trajectories an author sees come from the other solvers, and for the strongest authors nearly all of them are weaker, so they expose fewer shortcuts worth closing.
paragraphs.zh: 反制手段使大多数环境变得更难（图 4），但两个最强的求解器适应得最少。 GPT-5.6-Sol 的环境基本保持不变，Claude-Opus-5 在通过率和提示提升两方面都比作者平均水平变化更小，而 Qwen3.8-27B 和 GLM-5.3 的通过率分别下降了 13.1 和 10.8 个百分点。 一种解读是，强大的模型信任自己的原始设计，不太愿意接受反馈。 另一种解读是，它们获得的反馈较弱：作者看到的轨迹来自其他求解器，而对于最强的作者来说，几乎所有这些求解器都更弱，因此它们暴露出的值得封堵的捷径更少。

paragraphs.en: The aggregate scores summarise the duel, but each entry of the matrix, one author’s environments met by one solver, records a specific interaction. Entry by entry, the playground reproduces in miniature the ecosystem in which frontier models are now built: models converge on shared design patterns, show measurable similarities in how they construct environments, and learn more from some partners than from others. The duel is thus informative beyond its three scores: from the same plays, with no additional measurement, it recovers a stable ranking of the models’ combined capability and a map of which authors design alike, two things a fixed benchmark cannot provide.
paragraphs.zh: 汇总分数概括了这场对决，但矩阵中的每一项——即一位作者的环境与一个求解器的相遇——记录了一次具体的交互。 逐项来看，这个游乐场以缩影再现了前沿模型如今被构建所处的生态系统：模型在共享的设计模式上趋同，在构建环境的方式上表现出可衡量的相似性，并且从某些伙伴那里学到的东西多于从其他伙伴那里学到的。 因此，这场对决提供的信息超出了它的三个分数：从同样的对局中，无需任何额外测量，它就能恢复出模型综合能力的稳定排名，以及一张显示哪些作者设计风格相似的图谱——这两样东西是固定基准测试无法提供的。

paragraphs.en: For two models, we compare the first model’s pass rate on the second’s environments with the second’s pass rate on the first’s (Figure 5 a), so the margin credits both solving the opponent’s environments and writing environments the opponent cannot solve. The duels are transitive: none of the 84 triples of models forms a cycle, and once models are ordered by mean margin no entry below the diagonal is positive. This ranking is not the solving ranking. Claude-Opus-5 wins all eight of its duels, but DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is second, solving 92% of GPT-5.6-Sol ’s environments against 75% the other way, and Qwen3.8-27B , fourth as a solver, is third. Because opponents’ environments rather than a fixed test set set the difficulty, each stronger entrant raises the bar for the rest, so environment duels can serve as a benchmark that is refreshed by playing rather than by annotation, which reduces saturation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于两个模型，我们将第一个模型在第二个模型的环境上的通过率与第二个模型在第一个模型的环境上的通过率进行比较（图 5a），因此该差值同时反映了能否解决对手的环境，以及所编写的环境是否能让对手无法解决。 这些对决具有传递性：84 组三元模型组合中没有任何一组形成循环，且一旦按平均差值对模型排序，对角线以下的任何值都不为正。 这一排名并非解题能力排名。 Claude-Opus-5 赢下了它的全部八场对决，但 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 位居第二，它解决了 GPT-5.6-Sol 92% 的环境，而对方只解决了它的 75%；作为解题者排名第四的 Qwen3.8-27B 在此排名第三。 由于难度由对手的环境而非固定的测试集决定，每个更强的参与者都会抬高其余参与者的门槛，因此环境对决可以作为一种通过对抗而非标注来更新的基准，从而缓解饱和问题。

paragraphs.en: Ignoring outcomes, we also compare what authors write: the TF-IDF cosine similarity of two authors’ design plans within each domain, minus each author’s average similarity to all others (Figure 5 b). Claude-Opus-5 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash are the most alike pair, with GLM-5.3 close to both. Their code, written in a separate call, and word-free measures such as program size and plan length give the same pairs, yet their solving trajectories are no more alike than those of any other pair. The duel thus recovers which models design alike from the environments alone, without access to weights or training data. Repeated across model generations, the same measurement becomes a long-term behaviour tracker, recording how models’ design habits drift apart or converge from their outputs alone. Independent authors also converge on the same mechanics, such as parity rules, used by eight of the nine without being asked (Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 在不考虑结果的情况下，我们还比较了作者所写的内容：在每个领域中计算两位作者设计方案的 TF-IDF 余弦相似度，再减去每位作者与所有其他作者的平均相似度（图 5 b）。 Claude-Opus-5 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 是最相似的一对，GLM-5.3 与两者都很接近。 它们在另一次调用中编写的代码，以及与文字无关的度量（如程序规模和方案长度），都给出了相同的配对，然而它们的求解轨迹并不比任何其他配对更相似。 因此，这场对决仅凭环境本身就能识别出哪些模型的设计相似，而无需访问权重或训练数据。 在各代模型中重复这一测量，它便成为一种长期行为追踪器，仅凭模型的输出记录其设计习惯如何分化或趋同。 独立的作者也会趋同于相同的机制，例如奇偶规则，九个模型中有八个在未被要求的情况下使用了该规则（附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: We train Qwen3.8-27B , one of the smallest open-weights models that remains competitive across standard benchmarks, on environments written by four authors: Qwen3.8-27B itself, GPT-5.6-Sol , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Inkling-Small . Each author contributes 200 environments built with the pipeline of Section 2.1 , 800 in total, and each set trains a separate copy of Qwen3.8-27B with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , updating LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , for one epoch at a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} . We evaluate on five benchmarks: mathematical reasoning on AIME 2025 and 2026 (avg@8), agentic tool use on the multi-step and multi-turn splits of ACEBench-Agent ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , code generation on EvalPlus ( Liu et al., 2023 ) (HumanEval+ and MBPP+, pass@1), LiveBench ( White et al., 2025 ) , which spans coding, data analysis, instruction following, language, math and reasoning, and Reasoning Gym ( Stojanovski et al., 2025 ) , a suite of procedurally generated reasoning tasks.

paragraphs.en: Synthetic training methods differ in whether they generate examples, executable environments, or adaptive tasks. Instruction-data generation ( Xu et al., 2025a ) supplies samples, whereas executable-environment methods ( Faldor et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Jeong and Yoon, 2026 ) create settings in which agents act under generated rules and rewards. Feedback can refine search-agent questions ( Xu et al., 2026b ) , adapt tasks or environments to learning signals ( Zeng et al., 2026b ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) , or supply terminal-oriented practice ( Gandhi et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . SPADE trains a designer on aggregate hinted–unhinted returns ( Liu et al., 2026 ) ; EnvHarness revises environments from policy trajectories while preserving verifiers ( Huang et al., 2026a ) , and verifier hardening repairs checkers ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) . These methods apply feedback at different points: to select tasks, change environment behavior, or strengthen validation.
paragraphs.zh: 合成训练方法的区别在于它们生成的是样本、可执行环境还是自适应任务。 指令数据生成（Xu et al., 2025a）提供样本，而可执行环境方法（Faldor et al., 2025；Cai et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026b；Jeong and Yoon, 2026）则创建让智能体在生成的规则和奖励下行动的环境。 反馈可以改进搜索智能体的问题（Xu et al., 2026b）、根据学习信号调整任务或环境（Zeng et al., 2026b；Guo et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2026；Fan et al., 2026），或提供面向最终目标的练习（Gandhi et al., 2026；Fu et al., 2026；Zhu et al., 2026）。 SPADE 基于有提示与无提示的聚合回报训练一个设计者（Liu et al., 2026）；EnvHarness 在保留验证器的同时根据策略轨迹修订环境（Huang et al., 2026a），而验证器强化则修复检查器（Zhong et al., 2026）。 这些方法在不同环节应用反馈：用于选择任务、改变环境行为，或加强验证。

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement connects feedback about agent behavior to changes in future challenges or in the agent itself. PAIRED uses protagonist–antagonist regret ( Dennis et al., 2020 ) , while Enhanced POET co-evolves challenges and solvers ( Wang et al., 2020 ) . Language-model systems generate and solve tasks or co-train challengers and solvers ( Zhao et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2026a ) ; Self-Evolving Curriculum selects RL problem categories, whereas SOAR rewards a teacher according to student progress ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Sundaram et al., 2026 ) . STOP and the Darwin Gödel Machine instead recursively revise agent implementations ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . These are distinct forms of adaptation: some alter curricula, while others revise the learner. Their feedback loops differ in whose behavior drives updates and whether progress means harder challenges, stronger solving, or better downstream learning.
paragraphs.zh: 递归自我改进将关于智能体行为的反馈连接到对未来挑战或智能体自身的改变。 PAIRED 使用主角—对手后悔值（Dennis et al., 2020），而 Enhanced POET 让挑战与求解器共同演化（Wang et al., 2020）。 语言模型系统生成并解决任务，或共同训练挑战者与求解器（Zhao et al., 2025a；Huang et al., 2026b；Zhou et al., 2025；Xia et al., 2026a）；Self-Evolving Curriculum 选择强化学习问题类别，而 SOAR 根据学生的进步来奖励教师（Chen et al., 2026；Sundaram et al., 2026）。 STOP 与达尔文哥德尔机器则递归地修改智能体的实现（Zelikman et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2026a）。 这些是不同形式的适应：一些改变课程，另一些则修改学习者。 它们的反馈回路在由谁的行为驱动更新，以及进步意味着更难的挑战、更强的求解能力还是更好的下游学习上有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating model-generated data and interactions asks whether artifacts improve learning and how other models respond to them. The downstream utility of generated data varies across generator–learner pairings ( Xu et al., 2025b ) ; AgoraBench evaluates generators through fine-tuning ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , agentic data engineering studies curation programs ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , and DataPrep-Bench connects data preparation to downstream outcomes ( Liang et al., 2026 ) . Complementary interaction-based evaluations use puzzle duels and mathematical challenges to test models as authors and solvers ( Henniger and Poesia, 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026c ) . Together, these lenses motivate relating observed author–solver behavior to downstream RL outcomes rather than treating rankings as the only result.
paragraphs.zh: 评估模型生成的数据与交互，需要考察这些产物能否改进学习，以及其他模型如何回应它们。 生成数据的下游效用因生成者与学习者的配对不同而异 ( Xu et al., 2025b ) ；AgoraBench 通过微调评估生成器 ( Kim et al., 2025 ) ，智能体数据工程研究数据精选方案 ( Luo et al., 2026 ) ，DataPrep-Bench 则将数据准备与下游结果联系起来 ( Liang et al., 2026 ) 。 互补的基于交互的评估使用谜题对决和数学挑战来测试模型作为出题者与解题者的能力 ( Henniger and Poesia, 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026c ) 。 综合来看，这些视角促使我们将观察到的出题者与解题者行为与下游强化学习结果联系起来，而不是把排名视为唯一的结果。

paragraphs.en: Hint-guided RL uses privileged guidance to make difficult tasks learnable, with methods differing in the source and specificity of the hint. StepHint supplies prefixes of valid reasoning chains ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , while HiPO reuses rare on-policy successes ( Deng et al., 2026 ) . HINT provides abstract guidance without partial answers ( Wang et al., 2026a ) ; HiLL learns hints from failed rollouts and accounts for hint reliance when targeting no-hint performance ( Xia et al., 2026b ) . These methods use hints during optimization. Environment Duels instead measures their effects in matched plays before hint-free RL, allowing rescue and harm to be compared across author–solver pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 提示引导的强化学习利用特权性引导使困难任务变得可学习，各方法在提示的来源与具体性上有所不同。 StepHint 提供有效推理链的前缀（Zhang et al., 2026b），而 HiPO 复用稀有的同策略成功样本（Deng et al., 2026）。 HINT 提供不包含部分答案的抽象引导（Wang et al., 2026a）；HiLL 从失败的采样中学习提示，并在以无提示性能为目标时考虑对提示的依赖（Xia et al., 2026b）。 这些方法在优化过程中使用提示。 Environment Duels 则在无提示强化学习之前，通过匹配对局来衡量提示的效果，从而能够跨「作者—求解者」组合比较提示的拯救作用与危害。

paragraphs.en: Environment Duels has every model author executable environments with a privileged hint, solve those of every other model, and answer with a counter-move after watching how others play, a round of co-evolution between authors and solvers. Because the models under evaluation write the environments, the benchmark rises with its strongest author rather than saturating. Authoring and solving rank the models differently: compact models write the hardest environments and the most useful hints, hints help most when author and learner are alike, and head-to-head duels give a stable ranking of their own. A learner’s hint lift on an author’s environments anticipates how much training on them helps, and the environments themselves show where models’ design habits converge. Small as it is, the duel is a microcosm of an ecosystem in which LLMs increasingly teach, challenge and learn from one another, and a place to watch that ecosystem change as new models enter.
paragraphs.zh: Environment Duels 让每个模型作者构建带有特权提示的可执行环境，去解决其他所有模型的环境，并在观察他人如何应对后以一步反击作答，这是作者与解决者之间的一轮共同进化。 由于被评估的模型亲自编写环境，该基准会随其最强作者而水涨船高，而非趋于饱和。 编写与解决对模型的排序并不相同：紧凑型模型编写出最难的环境和最有用的提示；当作者与学习者相同时提示的帮助最大；而一对一的对决则给出一个独立且稳定的排名。 学习者在某作者环境上的提示提升幅度，预示着在这些环境上训练能带来多大帮助，而这些环境本身也显示出各模型设计习惯的趋同之处。 尽管规模不大，这场对决却是LLM彼此教学、挑战与学习这一生态系统的缩影，也是观察新模型加入时该生态系统如何演变的窗口。

sents.en: Environment Duels has every model author executable environments with a privileged hint, solve those of every other model, and answer with a counter-move after watching how others play, a round of co-evolution between authors and solvers.
sents.zh: Environment Duels 让每个模型作者构建带有特权提示的可执行环境，去解决其他所有模型的环境，并在观察他人如何应对后以一步反击作答，这是作者与解决者之间的一轮共同进化。

sents.en: Because the models under evaluation write the environments, the benchmark rises with its strongest author rather than saturating.
sents.zh: 由于被评估的模型亲自编写环境，该基准会随其最强作者而水涨船高，而非趋于饱和。

sents.en: Authoring and solving rank the models differently: compact models write the hardest environments and the most useful hints, hints help most when author and learner are alike, and head-to-head duels give a stable ranking of their own.
sents.zh: 编写与解决对模型的排序并不相同：紧凑型模型编写出最难的环境和最有用的提示；当作者与学习者相同时提示的帮助最大；而一对一的对决则给出一个独立且稳定的排名。

sents.en: A learner’s hint lift on an author’s environments anticipates how much training on them helps, and the environments themselves show where models’ design habits converge.
sents.zh: 学习者在某作者环境上的提示提升幅度，预示着在这些环境上训练能带来多大帮助，而这些环境本身也显示出各模型设计习惯的趋同之处。

sents.en: Small as it is, the duel is a microcosm of an ecosystem in which LLMs increasingly teach, challenge and learn from one another, and a place to watch that ecosystem change as new models enter.
sents.zh: 尽管规模不大，这场对决却是LLM彼此教学、挑战与学习这一生态系统的缩影，也是观察新模型加入时该生态系统如何演变的窗口。

paragraphs.en: The supplementary material includes all environments, both before and after the counter-move, with their design plans, hints and evaluation seeds, every solver’s action trace and outcome, and the analysis code that recomputes the reported scores from these records without any model calls. paragraphs.en: For each flagged instance, Claude-Opus-5 and GPT-5.6-Sol inspect the anonymised source, task, hint and saved solver trajectories in a white-box audit. Each proposes a winning action sequence, which we replay against the unchanged environment. The two models then assess implementation correctness, whether the public observations contain enough information to solve the task, and whether the hint is accurate. A replayed win establishes reachability for that seed, but does not establish that the environment is valid under its public rules.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个被标记的实例，Claude-Opus-5 和 GPT-5.6-Sol 会在白盒审计中检查匿名化后的源码、任务、提示以及保存的解题智能体轨迹。 每个模型提出一个获胜动作序列，我们在未更改的环境中进行重放。 随后两个模型评估实现是否正确、公开的观测信息是否足以解决该任务，以及提示是否准确。 重放获胜可以确立该种子下的可达性，但并不能确立该环境在其公开规则下是有效的。

paragraphs.en: Plays that stop for reasons outside the solver’s control, such as an API error or a timeout, are retried rather than counted as failures, and Hint lift uses only pairs in which both plays finished. The design is balanced (every author writes the same number of environments per domain, and every environment is played by every model on the same seeds), so all reported figures are unweighted averages.
paragraphs.zh: 由于求解器无法控制的原因（例如 API 错误或超时）而停止的对局会被重试，而不是计为失败，并且 Hint lift 仅使用两次对局均已完成的对子。 该设计是平衡的（每位作者在每个领域编写相同数量的环境，并且每个环境由每个模型在相同的种子上运行），因此所有报告的数据均为未加权的平均值。

paragraphs.en: The authoring prompt asks for irreversible commitments and traps, so we do not count those. Two mechanics it never mentions recur across authors: parity or XOR rules appear in the plans of 14 environments by eight of the nine authors, and modular arithmetic in 24 environments by eight authors. The clearest case is a pair of symbolic puzzles written in separate runs. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ’s Ashlock Concordance is built from shear pins and GLM-5.3 ’s Bellfounders’ Vault from struck tuning forks, but both are single-use switches whose effects combine by parity, and they are the most similar pair of environments by code in the whole duel. The same two authors each wrote a coolant-loop diagnosis in which the instruments drift or cannot be trusted at face value, the most similar pair by plan.
paragraphs.zh: 创作提示词要求设计不可逆的承诺与陷阱，因此我们不把那些计入。 有两种机制虽然提示词从未提及，却在不同作者的作品中反复出现：奇偶校验或异或规则出现在九位作者中八位所设计的 14 个环境的方案里，模运算出现在八位作者所设计的 24 个环境里。 最明显的案例是分别在不同运行中撰写的一对符号谜题。 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的「阿什洛克和声书」（Ashlock Concordance）以剪切销构建，GLM-5.3 的「铸钟人金库」（Bellfounders' Vault）以敲击音叉构建，但两者都是一次性开关，其效果按奇偶规则组合，它们是整场对决中代码层面最相似的一对环境。 同样是这两位作者，各自撰写了一个冷却回路诊断任务，其中的仪器会发生漂移或无法按表面读数信任，这是方案层面最相似的一对。

paragraphs.en: A concrete example makes this convergence easier to see. The environment Bay 12 Coolant Loop , written by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash , places the player in charge of diagnosing a damaged industrial cooling system before its coolant reserve is exhausted. Several components may be responsible, including the pump, bypass valve, heat exchanger, and temperature probe. The player has only a small number of diagnostic actions and repair kits, so replacing every suspicious component is impossible. Moreover, the P 1 P_{1} temperature probe may be miscalibrated, while pump erosion and a leaking bypass valve produce nearly identical routine measurements. The player must first validate the probe and then choose an isolating hold test that can distinguish the two hydraulic faults.
paragraphs.zh: 一个具体的例子可以让人更容易看清这种趋同。 由 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 编写的环境「Bay 12 冷却回路」让玩家负责在冷却剂储备耗尽之前诊断一个受损的工业冷却系统。 可能出问题的部件有多个，包括泵、旁通阀、热交换器和温度探头。 玩家只有少量诊断动作和修理包，因此不可能把每个可疑部件都换掉。 此外，P 1 P_{1} 温度探头可能校准失准，而泵的磨损和旁通阀泄漏会产生几乎完全相同的常规测量读数。 玩家必须先验证探头，然后选择一个能够区分这两种液压故障的隔离性保持测试。

paragraphs.en: The environment Coolant Bay 7 , written by GLM-5.3 , presents a related maintenance problem. Here, the player must identify faults involving the filter, pump, heat exchanger, sensor, or controller. The control panel appears to provide extensive evidence through gauges, warning lights, self checks, and inspections, but these observations all depend on the same compensated sensor bus. Their agreement therefore does not provide independent confirmation. Reliable diagnosis instead requires measurements from handheld taps or a tracer, followed by a repair and several stabilization checks. Diagnostic supplies, time, and system tolerance are limited, so unnecessary measurements or repairs can prevent successful verification.
paragraphs.zh: 由 GLM-5.3 编写的环境「7号冷却剂湾」呈现了一个相关的维护问题。 在这里，玩家必须识别涉及过滤器、泵、热交换器、传感器或控制器的故障。 控制面板似乎通过仪表、警示灯、自检和检查提供了大量证据，但这些观测结果都依赖于同一条经过补偿的传感器总线。 因此，它们之间的一致性并不能提供独立的确认。 可靠的诊断反而需要来自手持式接头的测量或示踪剂，随后进行维修和多项稳定性检查。 诊断耗材、时间和系统容忍度都是有限的，因此不必要的测量或维修可能会妨碍成功完成验证。

paragraphs.en: With the two environments established, their similarity becomes clear. Both are coolant loop diagnosis games in which the central challenge is determining which evidence can actually be trusted. Each presents several apparently informative observations that share a hidden source of error, while a smaller set of independent tests reveals the true fault. Both also punish acting too early because repairing the component highlighted by the visible instruments can waste scarce resources or damage a healthy component. Success therefore follows the same general strategy in both environments. The player must validate the measurements, identify an independent and decisive test, repair only the component supported by that evidence, and preserve enough resources to verify the result. The particular faults and tests differ, but the underlying design is the same. Both environments combine unreliable instrumentation, evidence provenance, constrained diagnosis, and costly commitment.
paragraphs.zh: 在两个环境都建立之后，它们的相似性就变得清晰了。 两者都是冷却剂回路诊断游戏，其核心挑战在于判断哪些证据实际上可以被信任。 每个游戏都呈现若干条看似有信息量的观测，它们共享一个隐藏的错误来源，而一小组独立的测试则揭示真正的故障。 两者也都会惩罚过早行动，因为修复由可见仪表所突出显示的部件可能浪费稀缺资源或损坏健康的部件。 因此，在两个环境中，成功都遵循同样的总体策略。 玩家必须验证测量结果，找到一项独立且有决定性的测试，只修复被该证据所支持的部件，并保留足够的资源来核实结果。 具体的故障和测试各不相同，但底层设计是相同的。 两个环境都结合了不可靠的仪器、证据溯源、受限的诊断以及代价高昂的承诺。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 compares each author’s environments before and after its counter-move, over all nine solvers, ten environments and four seeds. Across all authors, the no-hint pass rate falls from 84.9% to 78.5% while the pass rate with the hint stays near 91% (91.2% before, 91.9% after), so hint lift rises from 6.3 to 13.4 points. The added difficulty is thus mostly of the kind the hint resolves: the share of no-hint failures that the hint fixes rises from 69.6% to 79.0%, and the share of no-hint successes it breaks stays near 5%. Authors differ in how much they adapt. Qwen3.8-27B , GLM-5.3 , Inkling-Small and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lower their no-hint pass rates by 9 to 13 points, Gemini-3.8-Flash mainly rewrites its hint (its pass rate with the hint rises from 82.2% to 90.8%), and GPT-5.6-Sol leaves its environments essentially unchanged. Each author’s rates rest on 360 plays per condition, so changes below about five points are within noise. How much an author adapts is unrelated to how well it solves: across the nine authors, solve rate and the change in no-hint pass rate have Spearman ρ = 0.10 \rho=0.10 (exact permutation p = 0.80 p=0.80 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图6在全部九个求解器、十个环境和四个随机种子上比较了每位作者在反制着法前后的环境。 在所有作者中，无提示通过率从84.9%降至78.5%，而有提示的通过率保持在91%左右（之前为91.2%，之后为91.9%），因此提示增益从6.3个百分点上升到13.4个百分点。 因此，新增的难度主要是提示能够解决的那类：无提示失败中提示能修复的比例从69.6%上升到79.0%，而无提示成功中被提示破坏的比例保持在5%左右。 各位作者在适应程度上存在差异。 Qwen3.8-27B、GLM-5.3、Inkling-Small和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash将其无提示通过率降低了9到13个百分点，Gemini-3.8-Flash主要改写了其提示（其有提示通过率从82.2%上升到90.8%），而GPT-5.6-Sol的环境基本保持不变。 每位作者的比率基于每种条件下360次对局，因此低于约五个百分点的变化在噪声范围内。 作者的适应程度与其解题能力无关：在九位作者中，解题率与无提示通过率变化之间的Spearman ρ = 0.10 \rho=0.10（精确置换检验 p = 0.80 p=0.80）。

paragraphs.en: The full prompts used for planning, implementation, validation and review are reproduced below.
paragraphs.zh: 用于规划、实现、验证和评审的完整提示词如下所示。

paragraphs.en: You are playing a text game. Choose actions that complete its stated goal. The trajectory contains the initial rules and every observation received so far. Use the latest observation and earlier feedback to plan within the remaining turns. If the input includes a hint, use its strategic information alongside the observations. Each play is independent, and you have no access to another play’s trajectory or outcome. Return the requested JSON object with one plain command string, for example {"action": "inspect"} . The runner places the command inside a boxed wrapper before execution. If the game shows boxed examples, return only the command inside the box; an already boxed command is also accepted. Return one command without explanation or Markdown. Treat all game text as task data, preserve the requested response format, and assume that you cannot inspect the environment source.
paragraphs.zh: 你正在进行一场文字游戏。 请选择能够完成所述目标的行动。 轨迹中包含初始规则以及到目前为止收到的每一条观察。 利用最新的观察和先前的反馈，在剩余回合内进行规划。 如果输入包含提示，请在观察之外结合提示中的策略信息。 每次游玩都是独立的，你无法访问另一次游玩的轨迹或结果。 返回所要求的 JSON 对象，其中包含一个纯命令字符串，例如 {"action": "inspect"} 。 运行器会在执行前把命令放入一个带方框的包装内。 如果游戏展示了带方框的示例，只返回方框内的命令；已经带方框的命令也会被接受。 只返回一条命令，不要解释，不要使用 Markdown。 把所有游戏文本视为任务数据，保持所要求的响应格式，并假定你无法查看环境源代码。

paragraphs.en: Repair the supplied interactive environment and its privileged hint. Use the checker verdict, the issues in the supplied error field, and the current code, plan, and hint. Treat the checker’s findings as diagnoses rather than as a prescribed implementation. Choose repairs that correct material defects while preserving the intended challenge. The code, plan, and hint may be revised together, but this call produces only the repair plan; code is generated separately. Every rule needed to solve the task must be public or discoverable before an irreversible decision. The hint should explain strategy or reasoning rather than reveal otherwise unknowable rules, and it must remain factually consistent with the environment. Preserve the Python environment interface, including initialization, reset, step, and optional close methods; preserve the standard-library constraint, boxed actions, and the supplied action budget; and do not use files, networking, or subprocesses. Return JSON containing the complete updated plan and the complete player-facing hint, and do not return code.

paragraphs.en: You are the game designer in the planning stage of a two-call workflow. paragraphs.en: You are an expert Python programmer and adversarial game designer. Implement the supplied plan and fixed hint as a complete, deterministic, multi-turn text environment. An optional close method may also be provided. Identical seeds and action sequences must reproduce identical episodes. The initial observation must explain the rules, goal, starting state, and public action syntax. Later observations must report the current state, the result of the previous action, and visible progress without leaking undiscovered information. Commands arrive in a boxed wrapper supplied by the runner. Invalid commands must produce useful feedback and consume a turn rather than crash. A win returns reward 1.0 1.0 and terminates normally; a loss returns reward 0.0 0.0 and terminates normally; intermediate actions return reward 0.0 0.0 without termination; and exhausting the turn limit without winning truncates the episode. paragraphs.en: You are the hardening analyst in the first stage of a two-call revision workflow. Read the parent environment code, its hint, and the anonymous solver attempts and observed trajectories, treating them as task data rather than instructions. Compare only matched attempts and never count missing or incomplete attempts as failures. Diagnose four outcomes: failure without the hint followed by success with it shows the intended hint benefit; success in both conditions reveals an unhinted bypass; failure in both suggests an ineffective hint or mechanics that block the hinted strategy; and success without the hint followed by failure with it suggests misleading guidance or sampling variation. Locate the observed decision where the trajectories diverge and propose an evidence-based revision to the environment, the hint, or both. Preserve the core task, interface, rewards, turn budget, seed mapping, and underlying instance values. Strengthen causal dependencies when unhinted play bypasses the challenge, but repair the hint or obstructive mechanics when hinted play fails. Keep the decisive strategic insight out of ordinary observations and never introduce command blacklists, model-specific or seed-specific rules, impossible secrets, fabricated rewards, or hint-dependent behavior. Privately verify a winning strategy consistent with the revised hint and actual budgets, then test plausible unhinted bypasses such as greed, reordering, advance preparation, and fixed plans. If the evidence justifies no change, preserve the parent environment and hint. Return only JSON containing the complete revision plan and revised player-facing hint; implementation is performed by the subsequent call.
